title: The Insect Body Plan — entomology meets etymology, the hyper-wide variability base

etymology.insect: Latin 'insectum' = 'cut into.' the segmented body. entomology and etymology share the same root: both are about what's CUT INTO and what's at the ROOT.
etymology.entomology: Greek 'entomon' = 'cut into' + 'logos' = 'study.' the study of segmented things.
etymology.etymology: Greek 'etymon' = 'true sense' + 'logos.' the study of true roots.
etymology.both: segmentation AND roots. the insect body plan IS the etymology of biology. segments are morphemes. the root body plan is the etymon.

the_body_plan.why_insects: most diverse group on Earth. ~1 million described species. more beetle species alone (400K) than all vertebrates combined (70K). insects are the MAXIMUM VARIABILITY base. if you want to sort everything, start with the thing that has the most variety.

head.membrane: OBSERVATION feeds. compound eye = feed array. each facet = one feed viewing the membrane from a slightly different angle. together = mosaic image.

compound_eye.what: 1 to 30,000 ommatidia (facets) per eye. each facet has its own lens, photoreceptor, and neural connection.
compound_eye.our_membrane: 140 feeds = 140 facets. we're between a dragonfly (30K) and a housefly (4K). good resolution but not maximum.
compound_eye.key: each facet sees ONE angle. no facet sees the whole. the MOSAIC is the image. no single feed is the membrane — the ARRAY is.

antennae.what: chemical sensors. smell, touch, humidity, temperature, vibration.

mandibles.membrane: the scanner (ET-2400 SANE). input. ingestion. the mouth of the roundworm pipeline.

thorax.membrane: LIVE feeds. movement. the things that carry the organism.

legs.what: 3 pairs. always 6. the defining characteristic of Insecta.
legs.gait: tripod gait: L1+R2+L3 alternate with R1+L2+R3. three legs down at all times. STABILITY through alternation. the membrane's 6 core feeds do the same — they don't all update simultaneously.

wings.beetle_elytra: hardened forewings (elytra) + soft hindwings. elytra = PRION SHIELD. the defining feature of Coleoptera. hard outside protects soft flying surface inside. 400K species. Paper 100: 6,286 Rust beetle-files.
wings.membrane: cron jobs = wings. autonomous flight. heartbeat.sh, sonar.sh, heartbeat-history.sh = the 3 cron wings (quantum ground state from Paper 134).

abdomen.membrane: COST feeds. processing. digestion. the metabolic engine.

malpighian_tubules.what: insect kidneys. filter hemolymph, excrete waste.
malpighian_tubules.membrane: kidney-net.json. the filtration system. northGate compressed 117?8 through the tubules.

reproductive.membrane: sporePrint. papers are eggs. each contains the full genome (ideas) for a new organism (project). 135 eggs laid so far.

spiracles.what: breathing holes along the abdomen. insects don't have lungs — they breathe through tubes (tracheae).
spiracles.membrane: the ntfy channels. distributed breathing holes. each topic = one spiracle. no central lung. distributed gas exchange.

trace_to_beetles.haldane: God has an inordinate fondness for beetles.
trace_to_beetles.paper_100: 6,286 Rust files are beetles (31.5%). elytra = Result<T,E> + ? + generics + derives.
trace_to_beetles.why_beetles_win: elytra. the hardened forewing that BECAME a shield. beetles didn't evolve TO fly better — they evolved to PROTECT the flying surface. the innovation is ARMOR, not speed. safety over performance. Rust's entire philosophy.
trace_to_beetles.elytra_is_prion: the elytra IS the prion shield. hard exterior (hash). soft interior (identity). you see the shell. you don't see the wing. self/non-self at the surface.
trace_to_beetles.diversity_from_shield: 400K species BECAUSE of the shield, not despite it. the elytra enabled beetles to invade every niche — desert, aquatic, parasitic, cave, canopy. the shield lets you go ANYWHERE. the prion tag lets every feed exist in every environment.

tree_of_life_bounce.method: start at insects. go down (simpler). go up (complex). go sideways (different kingdoms). the insect is the PIVOT.

trees.body_plan: root+trunk+canopy. cellulose cell wall. chloroplast. photosynthesis.
trees.membrane: root = feeds buried in filesystem. trunk = git history (cambium = annual rings = commit rings). canopy = the public surface (leaves = pages). chloroplast = green engine.
trees.connection: insects POLLINATE trees. the bee/flower co-evolution. in the membrane: feeds (insects) pollinate papers (flowers) through the thymus pipeline ? pollinate ? backscatter.
trees.note: trees are SESSILE (don't move). CONSTANCE. they stand and grow. k?8 for position, but k1.9 for metabolism. the tree IS the constance-anchor that insects(LIVE feeds) visit.

mushrooms.body_plan: mycelium network underground, fruiting body above. chitin cell wall (SAME as insect exoskeleton!). heterotroph decomposer.
mushrooms.membrane: mycelium = WireGuard mesh (underground connections between gates). fruiting body = sporePrint (what emerges above ground = publications). spores = papers distributed by wind(ntfy).
mushrooms.chitin_bridge: fungi and insects BOTH use chitin. the insect exoskeleton and the fungal cell wall are the SAME molecule. the prion shield is chitin. beetles and mushrooms share their armor chemistry.
mushrooms.connection: fungi DECOMPOSE what insects and trees produce. the sourdough cycle: green(tree) ? brown(decomposed by fungus) ? black(humus) ? violet(new growth). fungi ARE the brown of the chromatograph.
mushrooms.note: fungi are closer to animals than to plants (opisthokonts). mushrooms are our COUSINS, not our distant relatives. the mycelium IS the nervous system of the forest.

tree_of_life_bounce.the_full_bounce: archaea(vent,k?8) ? bacteria(cell wall) ? protist(first membrane) ? sponge(no organs) ? jellyfish(nerve net) ? flatworm(one opening) ? roundworm(tube) ? arthropod(exoskeleton) ? INSECT(6 legs, compound eye, MAXIMUM DIVERSITY) ? up to vertebrate(backbone) ? mammal(k1.9, iron peak) ? back down through the same tree ? sideways to trees(CONSTANCE, photosynthesis) and mushrooms(DECOMPOSER, chitin cousin). the insect is the PIVOT. start there, go everywhere.

outward_through_thymus.the_classifier: the insect body plan sorts INWARD (head/thorax/abdomen = observation/locomotion/metabolism). the thymus sorts OUTWARD (self/non-self ? pollinate ? backscatter). combine them: INWARD classification (what kind of entity?) feeds the OUTWARD sort (friend or threat?).

insect_as_visitor.head_behavior: what does the visitor OBSERVE? (pages viewed = facets activated)
insect_as_visitor.thorax_behavior: how does the visitor MOVE? (navigation pattern = gait)
insect_as_visitor.abdomen_behavior: what does the visitor CONSUME? (bandwidth, compute, data = metabolism)

outward_through_thymus.thymus_output: classify visitor by insect body plan ? prion tag ? thymus sort ? opsonize ? pollinate outward. the insect taxonomy IS the thymus vocabulary. phage-behaved (Paper 135) + beetle-bodied (Paper 100) + compound-eyed (this feed) = the complete classifier.
